title: Lost Mary Maryliq Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Indulge in the berry brilliance of Lost Mary Maryliq's Blueberry Sour Raspberry, an e-liquid that strikes the perfect balance between sweet and sour. From the first inhale, the ripe and juicy Blueberries envelop your taste buds in a comforting sweetness. As you continue to vape, a layer of tart Raspberries emerges, cutting through the sweetness and adding a delicious complexity to your experience. The end result is a symphony of berry flavours that dance in harmony on your palate. With a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid provides a robust flavour profile and a smooth, satisfying throat hit. Ideal for those who love a burst of berries but still crave a tangy twist, Blueberry Sour Raspberry is a standout choice for vapers seeking a multidimensional flavour experience.
